representation: Canonical JSON tagged arrays, preserving every constructor tag, ordered binder/field/constructor/alternative list, type argument and body; arbitrary-precision integers use canonical decimal strings. Primitive/intrinsic tags are explicit and exhaustive.
roles: RuntimeIR, VerifiedIR and SpecializedIR use distinct artifact domains. The encoding carries no checked flag or transferable authority; even invalid construction IR is encodable.
bounds: Portable type/expression encoding uses decreasing depth fuel; exhaustion is an error. Host decoding enforces byte/depth/node bounds and iteratively validates the complete schema. The current pure encoder does not claim a global allocation/CPU budget.

pipeline.meaning: A single actual erasure, validation and TypeScript-emission execution returns snapshots of its stage values plus the target. The host requires the original live checked handle and re-derives admissions before invoking it. The native seed emits stage fields only after the explicit checked-host emit response.
pipeline.production: checked-build records separate source-check, Core-to-RuntimeIR, RuntimeIR-validation, and VerifiedIR-to-TypeScript edges, then the existing tsc edge. All listed stage bytes are retained in the archive.
pipeline.compatibility: Older compiler/seed APIs with no stage fields retain explicitly composite coverage. A present but malformed/failing staged API cannot fall back to a legacy emitter. Validation snapshots must preserve exact IR bytes; backend interior lowering/printing remain composite.

directJavaScriptPipeline.meaning: A single staged execution strictly validates erasure and specialization output, lowers once to JsIR, structurally validates and snapshots that exact JsIR, and prints the same value.
directJavaScriptPipeline.graph: Observed graph edges separately retain source checking/certification where present, erasure, strict IR validation, runtime interface, ABI plan, specialization, JsIR lowering and JavaScript printing. The archive replays supported scoped relations; global preservation is unproved.
directJavaScriptPipeline.remaining: Direct-JS promotion, complete lowering/printer preservation and independently established assurance remain pending.

directWasmPipeline.meaning: A single staged execution strictly validates erasure and specialization output, lowers once, completes the private bootstrap ABI, validates and snapshots the exact WasmIR, and encodes the same value.
directWasmPipeline.graph: Observed graph edges separately retain source checking/certification where present, erasure, strict validation, runtime interface, specialization, WasmIR lowering/ABI completion, and binary encoding.
directWasmPipeline.remaining: Broader target ABI adapters, full recursive-type equivalence and lowering/ABI/encoder preservation remain pending. The represented profile has portable operand/control/local/GC typing; the recorded 166c6a3 whole-Wasm fixed point is a scoped observation only.

assurance: Encoding/schema integrity and observed stage provenance only. The strict validator, erasure and emitter remain explicitly trusted unless independent evidence is attached.
remaining: Rust SpecializedIR and target-interior snapshots for all backends

closedInvariantReplay.constructionBoundary: Decoding yields construction IR only. Exact canonical re-encoding is required before fresh strict validation.
closedInvariantReplay.scope: Closed modules only. External imports require separate link-context replay and decline rather than accept.
closedInvariantReplay.authority: No serialized artifact creates CheckedCore or CertifiedSource; a successful report checks IR invariants only.
closedInvariantReplay.trust: Caller pins native validator bytes and selects a stable executable path/runtime. Global decoder/validator soundness and hostile-host isolation are unproved.

tuple: ordered [moduleId, exportNames, declaredCapabilities, canonical raw IR] units
linkedInvariantReplay.consumerPolicy: The consumer chooses the exact target/capability sequence and allowlists artifact identities of complete host contracts. An archived assumption label cannot authorize a new signature/layout. Linked exports are derived from actual declarations by the portable validator.
linkedInvariantReplay.validation: Exact canonical re-encoding, strict body/signature/layout checks, declared exports, capability propagation and acyclic dependency ordering. Host contract implementation behavior remains an explicit pinned assumption.
linkedInvariantReplay.archive: Optional irLinkValidation supplies one or more consumer-selected context artifacts and a pinned validator. Every retained verified/specialized IR subject must be covered by exact canonical bytes in a freshly accepted context; closed and linked replay modes are mutually exclusive. Contexts are not automatically discovered or given source authority.
linkedInvariantReplay.resourceScope: Each context is bounded in bytes/depth/nodes/native wall time/output; aggregate context bytes and count use archive limits. This is not a process sandbox or a globally proved cost bound.

validationEvidence.scope: complete main cloud workflow, native link/archive corpus and explicit PSC1 LinkArtifact source check
